question: Guruvayur Ekadashi is the cultural festival of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guruvayur Ekadashi** is a **Hindu festival **celebrated in the **Guruvayur temple** in **Kerala.**
 
• The festival usually falls in the month of **November or December.**
 
• Devotees fast on this day and offer prayers to** Lord Vishnu** for blessings and forgiveness.
 
• The festival is also known as** 'Mokshada Ekadashi'** and is considered one of the most important festivals in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka** is a state in **South India **known for its rich culture and heritage.

 
 
• The state celebrates many festivals such as **Mysuru Dasara, Ugadi, and Hampi Utsav.**
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is a state in South India known for its traditional **arts and crafts.**
 
 
• The state celebrates many festivals such as **Ugadi, Diwali, and Sankranti.**
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu **is a state in South India known for its **rich history and cultural heritage.**
 
 
• The state celebrates many festivals such as **Pongal, Diwali, and Tamil New Year.**
